finalText:
Fixed. Two real bugs from the bump were hiding under all that deprecation noise.

`src/core/options.js` still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. That crashed the whole build.

`src/net/retryPolicy.js` only accepted `true` or `false` for the backoff flag. The new config loader leaves it `undefined` when unset, so it threw. Now `undefined` is treated as `false`, same as before.

Build passes clean now. Exit code 0, 8 warnings, 0 errors, all just the deprecation noise from the bump.
